scope: Environment coverage of the delivered evaluation seed data/evaluation/seed.json, read at its clock. Only the seven record kinds of the plan count, each on the date field of an act that happened. Planned times are listed apart. Activity rows are not counted, because each repeats an act that a counted record already dates.
reproduce_note: Run it from the repository root. With --check it compares with the committed report.
date_rule: A timestamp counts on its calendar day in America/New_York after normalizing its UTC offset. A missing or invalid date is excluded and listed.

provenance.note: Counts are of the counted rows. Every record is synthetic: Benchline models no real cluster or website, so there is no real source to collect or to anchor.

app_records.kinds: configs, protocols, run_plans, jobs, tables, allocation_changes

activity.reason: Each activity row repeats a write, an event or an effect that a counted record already dates.

run_plans.reason: A run plan is world data that the cluster gives, and the App never shows it.

kinds.counts: the submission of a job, by the researcher, her script or a labmate. A submission is an act even when the job was held, cancelled or never ran.

the release of a notification that was released by the clock and not removed.
